description: pytest suite: pytest by file, under coverage.py when the suite names the packages it measures; a unittest suite runs under it unchanged. Tests are discovered by filename glob, either as siblings under the area's own paths or under a central root whose filename stem matches a changed source file; the whole suite is what pytest collects under the root.

project_dir.description: The directory the tests import from and run in, relative to the repository root; "." by default.

root.description: Directory under which the "filename" strategy looks for centralized tests, and the whole suite is collected from. Defaults to "tests".

glob.description: Filename glob(s) identifying this suite's test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns whose matches are unioned. Defaults to "test_*.py".

exclude.description: Filename glob(s) to drop from the matched test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns.

interpreter.description: The command that runs Python, one or several words: "python3" by default, or "uv run python" for a project whose environment uv keeps.

source.description: The packages or directories coverage.py measures, as its --source takes them. Empty by default, which runs the tests with no coverage and leaves coverage_summary with nothing to report.

report_dir.description: Where coverage.py's JSON report is written, relative to the repository root. Defaults to ".ops/cache/coverage/pytest".
